# Run recipe for the pilot of mmdbbench#164 on the mini (generated by build_recipe.py; no number or name below is typed)

Private notes. Nothing here may be queued before the owner has posted the registration (PREREG.md, section 12) on #164. The claims are `queue_add` calls of the Humem Tower; each one prompts the owner, and the write tools allow 10 calls per hour per area (humem-ops docs/write-tools.md). A session that carries this out does not post the registration and does not queue before the owner says so.

## Before the first claim

1. Tower `status`: the mini has no job, no gate and no study, and its heartbeat is current. `solo`, `compare1`, `compare2` and `compare3` are in drive mode (the mini's `worker.toml` says so since 2026-11-23). Nothing else is queued on the mini.
2. Nothing runs on the mini beside the pilot while a leg runs: no agent build, smoke or gate on any core (the rule of 2026-11-22: during a timed study only light work pinned to cores 18 and 19 from its first instruction, none at all while a leg runs).
3. The sensor and the counters the runner reads exist on the mini (read on 2026-11-24: `coretemp` is hwmon3, `thermal_throttle/core_throttle_total_time_ms` and `package_throttle_total_time_ms` exist, `uv python list` has 3.12).
4. The study folders are copied and checked (the copy lines of each leg).

## Order of the legs

| Leg | What | Claims | Hours low / central / high (cost_legs.py) |
|---|---|---|---|
| L0 | smoke of the chain on the mini (shortened, never data) | 4 | 0.2 / 0.2 / 0.3 |
| L1 | compute: probe cpu beside idle and compute neighbours | 9 | 1.0 / 1.0 / 1.3 |
| L2 | bandwidth stand-in: probe membw (compare1 only) beside idle and compute neighbours | 9 | 1.0 / 1.0 / 1.3 |
| L3 | probe cpu beside idle, compute and one membw stream (on compare1) | 9 | 1.1 / 1.1 / 1.5 |
| L4 | probe cpu beside idle, compute and one io stream (on compare1) | 9 | 1.1 / 1.1 / 1.5 |
| H | heat run: compare1 membw, compare2 cpu, compare3 cpu at once for 30 minutes (decides whether three busy lanes may be used) | 3 | 0.6 / 0.6 / 0.6 |

All six legs: 5.0 / 5.0 / 6.5 hours of host time (low / central / high), plus the time between stages. L0 first and read before anything else. L1 to L4 and H in any order after it; the registered order is the one above. Legs L5 and L6 (the real cells) are not claimable: `pilot_run.py` refuses them until the cell command is written and hashed (PREREG section 9).

## Leg L0: smoke of the chain on the mini (shortened, never data)

Study folder `pilot164-l0` on the mini (`~/humem-drill/repros/pilot164-l0/`). Order seed 20261124, salt 0, 6 units, 4 claims. sha256 of `order.json`: `1c13134ef342f85fdc605234e5a148a4f20b90782c158a5201a85686f927532a`.

Copy (from the laptop, key socket set; check before the first claim):

```
export SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/run/user/1000/gcr/.ssh
rsync -a /home/tk/build-scratch/pilot-permutation-20261124/studies/pilot164-l0/ mini:humem-drill/repros/pilot164-l0/
ssh mini 'cd humem-drill/repros/pilot164-l0 && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS && bash -n run_ab.sh && ls -l run_ab.sh'
```

Claims, in this order. Queue one stage, wait until every `analysis.txt` of the stage exists, then queue the next stage. The three claims of a compare stage are queued together (within a few minutes; the lanes meet at a rendezvous that waits 30 minutes). `cell_class` is the class of the heaviest stream the lane plays in the leg; `none` means the parameter is left out.

| Stage | `study` | `out` | `lane` | `cell_class` | `issue` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| s1 | `pilot164-l0` | `s1-solo` | `solo` | none | `humemai/mmdbbench#164` |
| s2 | `pilot164-l0` | `s2-c1` | `compare1` | `compute` | `humemai/mmdbbench#164` |
| s2 | `pilot164-l0` | `s2-c2` | `compare2` | `compute` | `humemai/mmdbbench#164` |
| s2 | `pilot164-l0` | `s2-c3` | `compare3` | `compute` | `humemai/mmdbbench#164` |

`note` of every claim of the leg: the text in the `note` field of `orders/order-L0.json` (at most 200 characters), for example `pilot of #164, leg L0, stage s1, lane solo; order.json in the study folder`. `host` is `mini`.

A compare stage whose rendezvous failed (a claim exits 4 because a lane never started; no unit ran) is queued again, all three claims, with `-r2` appended to every `out` (the runner finds the claim by the name without the suffix and gives the stage its own sync folder). Nothing else is ever queued twice.

Wait line after a stage (read only):

```
ssh mini 'ls -l humem-drill/repros/pilot164-l0/*/analysis.txt'
```

After the last stage (fetch and read):

```
rsync -a mini:humem-drill/repros/pilot164-l0/ /home/tk/build-scratch/pilot-permutation-20261124/results/pilot164-l0/
cd ~/repos/humemai/mmdbbench/.notes/bench/pilot-permutation-20261124 && uv run --no-project python -I analyze.py --order orders/order-L0.json --rows /home/tk/build-scratch/pilot-permutation-20261124/results/pilot164-l0 --out-dir /home/tk/build-scratch/pilot-permutation-20261124/results/pilot164-l0-analysis
```

Read the rows of L0 before L1: every `ok`, the three lanes of a unit start within a second of each other (`t_start`), `cpus_allowed` equals `cpus_expected` in every row, `throttle_ms` is a number, `gate_ok` is true, and the claims of stage s2 overlapped in time. The rows of L0 carry `shortened` and are never data.
